parent: H1_TREND_PULLBACK_V1 — rejected at development stress gate
single_change: After the same confirmed breakout pullback, place the 30-minute post-only limit at the midpoint of the 15m confirmation candle body instead of the breakout-zone edge.
rationale_before_results: V1 produced only 3 stress fills from 16 development candidates: seven limits expired and six candidates failed the cost/reward gate. A body-midpoint limit tests a normal shallow micro-retest while still refusing a market chase. Trend, displacement, confirmation, stop, target, session, risk and gates are unchanged.

unchanged_setup.displacement: 15m break of prior 20-bar extreme by 0.05 ATR, body >=0.80 ATR, volume >=1.20x median, outer-quartile close
unchanged_setup.confirmation: 15m rejection body >=0.25 ATR plus closed 5m break of prior two bars

gates.development_stress: at least 40 fills, net PnL > 0, PF > 1.10 and mean net R > 0
gates.validation_stress: at least 20 fills, net PnL >= 0, PF >= 1.00, at least two positive symbols, largest symbol <=60% of gross profit

research_budget: This is the final H1 variant on the shared historical sample. Failure closes H1; no V3 parameter adjustment is allowed.
promotion: A historical pass authorizes only a newly frozen paper-forward plugin. Live remains disabled.
